items.title: BumaStemra Officially Takes Legal Action Against YourNeuroTune
items.excerpt: BumaStemra has taken legal action against YourNeuroTune for allegedly providing businesses with royalty-free music generated via Suno. Follow-up to the 11-25 ultimatum card: the threat is now an actual legal action.

items.title: Sampleson Releases Free Version of Local AI Audio Search Tool Wavefinder
items.excerpt: Wavefinder finds sounds in a local library by describing them in text or loading a reference file, ranking matches by similarity in about 0.5s; the AI model runs locally and the new free tier uses the same engine but shows the top 3 results.

items.title: Guitarist George Lynch on his 'very strange' session for an AI track
items.excerpt: Ex-Dokken guitarist George Lynch says he unwittingly played a session on an AI-generated progressive track with never-repeating changes, calling it impressive and strange and asking why they wanted a human at all.

items.title: Tips on how to use Meta Muse for an artist's social media strategy
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse AI agent arrived in the UK this week after its US launch; Instagram's Adam Mosseri outlines three jobs for social-account runners (ideation, reviewing past posts by performance, spotting cross-platform trends) and admits audience analysis is still weak.

items.title: Mooer GTRS Wing 1000: Intelligent Headless Guitar with NAM!
items.excerpt: Mooer's new headless 'intelligent' guitar adds support for A1 and A2 Neural Amp Model captures, imported via GTRS Studio, alongside its onboard G200 SmartBox effects, wireless and USB-C DAW recording. (NAM-adjacent: Mooer Future Flex 11-22 and TONE3000 11-26 already carded.)

items.title: AI Companies Want Independent Music. This Time, They're Asking Permission.
items.excerpt: Analysis of AI music startup Sonilo's opt-in training-licence deal with distributor Symphonic (announced Nov 18): 80/20 revenue split, account-wide opt-in, licences that survive termination, plus five questions artists should ask before licensing music to AI.

items.title: Musixmatch launches enhanced Musixmatch Pro For Artists platform
items.excerpt: Musixmatch Pro for Artists expands beyond lyric distribution with enhanced AI-powered lyric transcription and time-sync tools, fan engagement analytics and lyric merch sales; MBW reports optional AI licensing is coming soon. (Published time from Google News index; page shows November 26th 2026.)

items.title: '머무르' 다음은 AI 아이돌…K팝의 새 얼굴
items.excerpt: AI 음원이 차트 1위에 오른 데 이어 AI 아이돌 그룹이 잇따라 등장: 서리아(이미지 5천 장, 4개월 제작), 리아, 히어러스 등. 비주얼 일관성과 저작권이 과제. (서리아는 11-25 카드 — 롤업 성격, 중복 주의)

items.title: The AI revolution is coming for your electronic instruments
items.excerpt: A new era of AI-assisted modding has arrived; MusicRadar talks to Elektron and Akai about the opportunities and challenges for hardware instrument makers when users can rewrite firmware with AI coding tools like Claude. (Date and image from MusicRadar RSS; page 403s to curl.)

items.title: Beat This! Live - Online Beat and Downbeat Tracking by Predicting the Future
items.excerpt: Adapts the offline Beat This model into a causal, low-latency variant for real-time beat and downbeat tracking (relevant to live performance/DJ tools), trained with temporally shifted labels so it predicts beats slightly ahead.

items.title: Music Similarity Estimation from Jukebox Embeddings
items.excerpt: JukeSim estimates content-based music similarity from embeddings of the generative model Jukebox, matching a learned baseline and beating hand-designed approaches; aimed at cold-start recommendation.

items.title: Line-Level Singer Diarization in Multi-Member Pop Songs: A Benchmark, Lead-Vocal Isolation, and Song-Level Decoding
items.excerpt: Introduces ColorCoded-SD, a benchmark of 43 K-pop songs (1,740 lines, 3-8 singers) for grouping lyric lines by singer, where commercial speech diarizers find only one or two speakers.
